newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU must restore faith in blood products - Irish minister.
newsitem.headline: EU must restore faith in blood products - Irish minister.

text.p: Irish Health Minister Michael Noonan has called for regulations in all EU states to restore public confidence in blood and blood products, the Irish Times reported on Thursday.
Noonan said problems such as hepatitis C had lowered the public's trust in blood transfusions and that procedures for quality assurance, licensing and inspection of transfusion centres varies.

"There is a lack of confidence in some member states regarding the standards of quality and safety of blood in other member states, which undoubtedly has serious implications for the attainment of the goal of self-sufficiency," he told a conference on blood safety in Limerick.
EU health ministers will meet on Friday in Limerick to discuss recommendations made during the conference by blood experts.
